title: Welcome to Woot Health
description: Frequently asked questions about the Woot Health Provider Dashboard, enrollee verification, pre-authorization workflows, payment tracking, QR validation, notifications, and provider utilities.

faqs.question: What is the Woot Health Provider Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The Woot Health Provider Dashboard is a self-service platform that enables healthcare providers to verify enrollees, request and manage pre-authorization codes, track authorization and payment statuses, validate approvals through QR scanning, and manage provider-related operations from one place.

faqs.question: Why was the Provider Dashboard created?
faqs.answer: The dashboard was created to reduce delays, inefficiencies, and poor provider experiences caused by fragmented healthcare verification and authorization workflows.

faqs.question: Who can use the Provider Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The dashboard is designed for healthcare providers, hospitals, clinics, and authorized personnel within the Woot Health provider network.

faqs.question: What problems does the dashboard solve?
faqs.answer: The dashboard simplifies enrollee verification, pre-authorization requests, payment tracking, QR validation, and support access while reducing manual follow-ups and delays.

faqs.question: What is the primary goal of the Provider Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The primary goal is to deliver a transparent, secure, scalable, and fast provider experience for enrollee verification and pre-authorization management across web and mobile.

faqs.question: What are the key objectives of the platform?
faqs.answer: The objectives include enabling instant enrollee verification, centralizing pre-authorization management, reducing delays, minimizing provider friction, supporting QR-based validation, and ensuring security and auditability.

faqs.question: What business objectives does the dashboard support?
faqs.answer: The dashboard helps improve provider satisfaction, reduce support workload, accelerate patient service delivery, and increase adoption of digital healthcare workflows.

faqs.question: How does enrollee verification work?
faqs.answer: Providers can search for enrollees using unique identifiers such as enrollee ID. The system validates identity, plan status, coverage validity, and service eligibility in real time.

faqs.question: What information is checked during verification?
faqs.answer: The platform verifies enrollee identity, active plan status, coverage validity, and healthcare service eligibility.

faqs.question: What happens if an enrollee record is inactive or invalid?
faqs.answer: The dashboard displays an error and prevents unauthorized healthcare service delivery for invalid, expired, or inactive enrollee records.

faqs.question: Why is real-time verification important?
faqs.answer: Real-time verification reduces fraud, prevents service denial errors, and ensures healthcare services are delivered only to eligible enrollees.

faqs.question: What is a P-A request?
faqs.answer: A P-A request is a Prior Authorization request submitted by a provider before certain healthcare services are approved and delivered.

faqs.question: How do providers create a P-A request?
faqs.answer: After enrollee verification, providers can select a healthcare service, input required clinical information, and submit the request through the dashboard.

faqs.question: What happens after a P-A request is submitted?
faqs.answer: The support team reviews the request and generates a unique pre-authorization code linked to the enrollee, provider, service type, and request timestamp.

faqs.question: Can duplicate P-A requests be submitted?
faqs.answer: No. The system validates and prevents duplicate or conflicting pre-authorization requests.

faqs.question: Can providers view previous P-A requests?
faqs.answer: Yes. Providers can access a centralized history of all past and ongoing pre-authorization requests.

faqs.question: What statuses are available for P-A requests?
faqs.answer: Statuses may include Pending, Approved, Rejected, Expired, and Used.

faqs.question: Can providers filter request history?
faqs.answer: Yes. Providers can filter requests by date, enrollee, service type, or request status.

faqs.question: What details are included in request history?
faqs.answer: Providers can view audit timestamps, request timelines, and detailed request information.

faqs.question: Can providers track payment statuses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Providers can monitor payment statuses associated with completed or approved healthcare services.

faqs.question: What payment statuses are available?
faqs.answer: Payment statuses may include Pending, Processing, Paid, and Failed.

faqs.question: Why is payment visibility important?
faqs.answer: Payment visibility reduces uncertainty and improves trust between providers and the platform.

faqs.question: Is payment status different from authorization status?
faqs.answer: Yes. Authorization status confirms service approval, while payment status reflects claim processing and settlement.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of QR code scanning?
faqs.answer: QR scanning allows providers to instantly verify enrollee identity and validate associated pre-authorization codes using a mobile device.

faqs.question: How does QR validation work?
faqs.answer: Providers scan an enrollee QR code using the mobile app camera. The system automatically retrieves enrollee information and validates authorization details in real time.

faqs.question: What happens if a QR code is invalid or expired?
faqs.answer: The dashboard displays an error for invalid, expired, or previously used QR codes.

faqs.question: Does the mobile app sync with the web dashboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. QR validation and enrollee information synchronize seamlessly across mobile and web platforms.

faqs.question: Will providers receive notifications?
faqs.answer: Yes. The dashboard provides in-app and system notifications for important provider-related events.

faqs.question: What types of notifications are available?
faqs.answer: Notifications may include approvals, rejections, expirations, payment updates, and verification failures.

faqs.question: What are audit logs used for?
faqs.answer: Audit logs ensure accountability, transparency, and traceability by recording important provider and authorization activities.

faqs.question: What information is stored in audit logs?
faqs.answer: Audit logs capture enrollee verification activity, P-A request creation, status changes, timestamps, and user actions.

faqs.question: Does the dashboard include a Help Center?
faqs.answer: Yes. Providers can access guides, FAQs, and contextual support resources within the dashboard.

faqs.question: Can providers manage account settings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Providers can manage account preferences and notification settings through the Settings section.

faqs.question: Is secure logout supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports secure logout and session termination to protect sensitive healthcare information.

faqs.question: Is provider and enrollee data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. The dashboard is designed with security, auditability, and scalability in mind to protect sensitive healthcare data.

faqs.question: Does the system support compliance and accountability?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive audit logs and secure workflows ensure transparency and compliance across provider operations.

faqs.question: How can providers get help?
faqs.answer: Providers can access support through the Help Center and other support channels available within the dashboard.

faqs.question: What happens if there is a verification or authorization issue?
faqs.answer: Providers receive notifications and can review request details or contact support for assistance.
